pairs: And Moses summoned all of Israel,
quæ ego loquor in auribus vestris hodie:
which I am speaking to your ears on this day.
Dominus Deus noster pepigit nobiscum fœdus in Horeb.
The Lord our God formed a covenant with us at Horeb.
Non cum patribus nostris iniit pactum,
He did not make the covenant with our fathers,
sed nobiscum qui in præsentiarum sumus,
who are alive and in the present time.
Facie ad faciem locutus est nobis in monte de medio ignis.
He spoke to us face to face on the mountain, from the midst of fire.
for I was in the middle between the Lord and you,
to announce his words to you.
For you were afraid of the fire,
and so you did not ascend to the mountain.
qui eduxi te de terra Ægypti,
who led you away from the land of Egypt,
Non habebis deos alienos in conspectu meo.
You shall not have strange gods in my sight.
You shall not make for yourself a graven image,
et quæ versantur in aquis sub terra.
or which abides in the waters under the earth.
Non adorabis ea, et non coles.
You shall not adore and you shall not worship these things.
Ego enim sum Dominus Deus tuus:
For I am the Lord your God,
reddens iniquitatem patrum super filios in tertiam et quartam generationem his qui oderunt me:
repaying the iniquity of the fathers upon the sons to the third and fourth generation to those who hate me,
et faciens misericordiam in multa millia diligentibus me,
and acting with mercy in thousands of ways to those who love me
Non usurpabis nomen Domini Dei tui frustra:
You shall not use the name of the Lord your God in vain.
quia non erit impunitus qui super re vana nomen ejus assumpserit.
For he will not go unpunished who takes up his name over an unimportant matter.
Observe the day of the Sabbath,
so that you may sanctify it,
sicut præcepit tibi Dominus Deus tuus.
just as the Lord your God has instructed you.
you shall labor and do all your work.
The seventh is the day of the Sabbath,
the rest of the Lord your God.
Non facies in eo quidquam operis tu,
You shall not do any work in it,
et peregrinus qui est intra portas tuas:
nor the sojourner who is within your gates,
so that your men and woman servants may rest,
Memento quod et ipse servieris in Ægypto,
Remember that you also were servants in Egypt,
et eduxerit te inde Dominus Deus tuus in manu forti,
and the Lord your God led you away from that place with a strong hand and an outstretched arm.
Idcirco præcepit tibi ut observares diem sabbati.
he has instructed you so that you would observe the Sabbath day.
sicut præcepit tibi Dominus Deus tuus,
just as the Lord your God has instructed you,
so that you may live a long time,
et bene sit tibi in terra,
and so that it may be well with you in the land,
quam Dominus Deus tuus daturus est tibi.
which the Lord your God will give to you.
And you shall not commit adultery.
And you shall not commit theft.
nec loqueris contra proximum tuum falsum testimonium.
Neither shall you speak false testimony against your neighbor.
You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife,
nor anything out of all that is his.’
Hæc verba locutus est Dominus ad omnem multitudinem vestram in monte de medio ignis et nubis,
The Lord spoke these words to the entire multitude of you on the mountain,
from the midst of the fire and the cloud and the darkness,
et scripsit ea in duabus tabulis lapideis,
And he wrote them on two tablets of stone,
Vos autem postquam audistis vocem de medio tenebrarum,
Then, after you heard the voice from the midst of the darkness,
and you saw the mountain burning,
accessistis ad me omnes principes tribuum et majores natu,
you approached me, all you leaders of the tribes and those greater by birth.
Ecce ostendit nobis Dominus Deus noster majestatem
the Lord our God has revealed to us his majesty and his greatness.
vocem ejus audivimus de medio ignis,
We have heard his voice from the midst of fire,
and we have proven today that,
though God is speaking with man,
et devorabit nos ignis hic maximus?
and why should this very great fire devour us?
si enim audierimus ultra vocem Domini Dei nostri,
For if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any longer,
Quid est omnis caro, ut audiat vocem Dei viventis,
What is all flesh, that it would hear the voice of the living God,
qui de medio ignis loquitur sicut nos audivimus,
who speaks from the midst of fire, just as we have heard it,
et audi cuncta quæ dixerit Dominus Deus noster tibi:
you should approach and listen to all the things that the Lord our God will say to you.
And you will speak to us,
and we will listen and do these things.’
But when the Lord had heard this,
Audivi vocem verborum populi hujus quæ locuti sunt tibi:
‘I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they spoke to you.
All this, they have spoken well.
Quis det talem eos habere mentem,
Who will grant to them to have such a mind,
so that they may fear me,
et custodiant universa mandata mea in omni tempore,
and may keep all my commandments at all times,
ut bene sit eis et filiis eorum in sempiternum?
so that it may be well with them and with their sons forever?
But as for you, stand here with me,
et loquar tibi omnia mandata mea, et cæremonias atque judicia:
and I will speak to you all my commandments and ceremonies, as well as judgments.
so that they may do them in the land,
which I will give to them as a possession.
et facite quæ præcepit Dominus Deus vobis:
keep and do the things which the Lord God has commanded you.
sed per viam, quam præcepit Dominus Deus vester,
For you shall walk in the way that the Lord your God has instructed,
and it may be well with you,
et protelentur dies in terra possessionis vestræ.
and your days may be extended in the land of your possession.’”
